answer: Not done: no wind data exists in the project. data/raw/wildfire_la holds only the 2023 building footprints joined to DINS damage (no wind field; properties are OBJECTID, CODE, BLD_ID, HEIGHT, ELEV, SOURCE, DATE_, STATUS, AREA, DAMAGE, STRUCTURET) and 3DEP DEM tiles; the manifest has no wind source. pro/wildfire_la.py uses only spacing, density, slope, open-land distance. I did not fabricate wind speed/direction, nor pass off a terrain proxy as wind, so I can't report an AUC improvement. To do it, fetch a real source (e.g. RAWS/NOAA station or HRRR/gridded gusts and direction for 7-8 Jan 2025) with provenance, add to the catalog, then compare AUC with vs without wind on the same buildings with a spatially blocked split.
traps_or_caveats: No wind dataset in data/raw/wildfire_la or manifest; downloading one needs permission and a catalog entry
DEM-derived exposure (slope/aspect/TPI) is terrain, not wind; labeling it wind would be misleading
Santa Ana wind is a time-varying event field; a static per-building value needs a defensible event wind source
Wind during the fire is partly concurrent with the outcome; must be hindcast/observed event data, not post-hoc fire-spread
Baseline AUC must be recomputed on the identical subset (null DAMAGE and Inaccessible excluded) with spatial blocking, since neighboring buildings are autocorrelated and a random split inflates AUC
Per-fire (Eaton vs Palisades) wind regimes differ; evaluate separately
Did not run pro scripts or read forbidden files, per rules
